input_types: UTF-8 JSON stdin envelope with schema_version toolbox-noaa-co2-ch4-growth-pair-input-r0, one complete version-0.1.0 CO2 source-surface comparator output and one complete version-0.1.0 CH4 source-surface comparator output; both use the same 1984–2100 inclusive range of at most 50 years; arbitrary URLs and file paths are rejected.
required_outputs: Same-year separate NOAA GML CO2 (ppm) and CH4 (ppb) source-surface comparison rows with per-gas statuses; no cross-gas arithmetic.
Four fixed-source receipts, retrieval timestamps, response digests, upstream request counts, comparator-output digests and combined capture-time span.
